# Cart

> **This document is sharded.** The files linked in the map below are the document. Read the map, then open only the shards you need. Each shard's frontmatter names this file (`part_of`) and holds the shard's own map entry (`title`, `summary`, `group`, and `related` for shards a change to it usually touches). To change the document, edit the shards directly: put new content in the shard a reader would look in first; when what a shard covers changes, update its `summary` and its line in the map to match; for a new shard, create a file in this folder with the same frontmatter and add its line to the map; when the folder has `identifier-lookup.md`, update the row of each identifier you add, move or remove. `.source/` holds the original as it was before sharding; it is frozen and out of date, so never read or edit it.
